meta.review_notes: The scraper was blocked by the H&M website (Akamai/EdgeSuite access denied) and could not retrieve the actual privacy policy text. Only cookie-banner disclosures were captured. All categories without explicit evidence were marked unknown. A manual review with the full privacy policy is strongly recommended before publishing.

app.name: H&M
app.description: The official H&M shopping app for browsing and purchasing fashion and home products, managing orders, and accessing member-exclusive offers.

verdict.one_liner: Limited disclosures confirm tracking and ad data sharing, but most privacy practices remain unverified.
verdict.summary: The scraper could not retrieve the full H&M privacy policy due to website blocking. Only cookie-banner text was captured. That text confirms the app collects browsing patterns and device data, shares it with advertising partners, and may process data outside the EU/EEA. Because the actual policy is missing, most privacy categories were marked unknown and the score reflects high uncertainty.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The available cookie disclosures indicate behavioural tracking and sharing of data with advertising partners. Without the full privacy policy, important practices such as data deletion, location use, and children's protections are completely unknown.

red.title: Personalized ads via third-party tracking
red.plain_english: The cookie banner says the app uses tracking technologies from third-party publishers to deliver personalized advertising on websites, apps, newsletters, and social media.

red.title: Data shared with advertising partners
red.plain_english: The cookie banner explicitly says your information is shared with third parties such as advertising partners, and in some cases your data may be processed outside the EU/EEA.

red.title: Privacy policy could not be fully retrieved
red.plain_english: The H&M website blocked the scraper, so the actual privacy policy text is missing. Most privacy categories had to be marked unknown, which means there are large gaps in our understanding of how this app handles your data.

green.title: You can block optional tracking cookies
green.plain_english: The cookie banner gives you an option to choose 'Only required cookies' instead of accepting all tracking and marketing cookies, which limits some data collection.

green.title: Cookies stored only as long as needed
green.plain_english: The cookie banner states that cookies and data are stored only for as long as needed to fulfill their purpose.
